reason: This plugin is primarily an external-academic-service integration for DeepSeek Harness: the README describes 38 built-in tools for scholarly search, paper metadata/detail retrieval, citation graph queries, DOI/full-text access, and citation/figure helpers, with configuration and execution tied to a DSH plugin row (`ai4scholar`) and API key resolution. The package export and dependency setup confirm it is a dsh web plugin plus client-side settings card, so user impact is research/tooling access rather than local code execution.

summaries.zh: AI4Scholar 插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供学术文献服务，连接 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、arXiv 等平台，支持论文检索、详情查看、下载全文与引用辅助。
summaries.en: AI4Scholar for DeepSeek Harness adds academic literature tools that connect to AI4Scholar-backed sources like Semantic Scholar, PubMed, and arXiv for paper search, metadata lookup, full-text access, and citation support.

capabilities: Search and retrieve academic literature across Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, and DOI sources
Resolve paper/author metadata, citations, references, and related records from external research APIs
Download and read paper PDFs and extract text in configurable chunks
Generate citation outputs and provide citation/listing helper utilities
Query account credit/balance information via a dedicated endpoint
